registry.name: Finitude
registry.statement: All carriers, probes, operators, paths, registries, and witnesses are finite.

enforcement.static_check: Require explicit finite dimensions/counts; reject continuum or completed-infinity primitives.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Every sim reports finite carrier_dim, finite path_count/registry_count, and terminates.
enforcement.current_status: clean rebuild 001-008 all use finite fixtures; old Tier Status says original Resolution 0 had no executable validator.

registry.name: Noncommutation
registry.statement: Composition is order-sensitive in general; AB and BA cannot be swapped by default.

enforcement.static_check: Require at least one named noncommuting operator pair or channel composition.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Measure order gap against a commuting negative control.
negative_controls: maximally mixed/joint eigenspace state that hides order
enforcement.current_status: clean rebuild 001 order gap is nonzero and commuting control collapses.

registry.name: No Primitive Identity
registry.statement: Identity is admitted only relative to a finite probe family; no bare token self-identity is primitive.

enforcement.static_check: Reject bare a == a / object-id identity claims as evidence.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Build finite probe family and show identity is stable across the active probes.
negative_controls: same memory/object id treated as ontology
enforcement.current_status: iter_223 says no_primitive_identity remains not gated in Codex's older scouts.

registry.name: Probe-Relative Indistinguishability
registry.statement: a ~ b iff all admissible finite probes in the active family fail to distinguish them.

enforcement.static_check: Reject single-probe equality unless the probe family is declared complete for the claim.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Compare probe vectors across a finite active family; richer probes must catch z-only equality smuggling.
enforcement.current_status: side-quest iter_223 gates this; clean rebuild still needs a torch-native canonical gate if promoted.

registry.name: Boundary/Contrast Identity Principle
registry.statement: Self-identity in the doctrine sense requires boundary or contrast under admissible probes.

enforcement.static_check: Reject identity claims that do not name a contrast class or boundary probe.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Show the candidate remains distinguishable from a matched null under finite probes.
enforcement.current_status: partially covered by no-center gates in older formal scouts; not isolated in clean rebuild.

registry.name: No Primitive Time Or Causality
registry.statement: Ordered composition exists without wall-clock time; causal order is earned by algebraic order content.

enforcement.static_check: Ban wall-clock variables as explanatory primitives for order.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Show noncommuting order gap and commuting order collapse on the same finite carrier.
enforcement.current_status: clean rebuild 001/005 use finite path order; side-quest iter_223 gates EC11.

registry.name: No Primitive Coordinates, Metric, Or Geometry
registry.statement: Coordinate charts, metrics, and geometry are induced after the finite QIT carrier, not primitive.

enforcement.static_check: Reject raw coordinate distance or chart labels as invariant evidence.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Use invariant readouts such as trace distance plus chart-scramble controls.
enforcement.current_status: clean rebuild 002 derives Hopf/Weyl readouts from spinors; side-quest EC15 gate is advisory.

registry.name: No Closure By Default
registry.statement: Closure, completeness, associativity, identity, and inverse properties must be earned for each operation family.

enforcement.static_check: Reject group/semigroup claims unless closure properties are explicitly checked.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Test operation family with identity/inverse/closure controls; amplitude damping should fail inverse.
enforcement.current_status: side-quest EC12 exists; clean rebuild does not yet isolate an EA06 gate.

registry.name: Finite Witness Discipline
registry.statement: Every admissible claim requires a finite, reproducible witness.

enforcement.static_check: Reject prose-only claims without receipt path, finite fixture, and reproducible command.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Fresh rerun reproduces the finite receipt.
enforcement.current_status: clean rebuild 001-008 have receipts; broad formal estate remains dirty/contaminated.

registry.name: No Cloning Or Broadcasting For Noncommuting States
registry.statement: Nonorthogonal/noncommuting states cannot be copied or broadcast by one admissible operation.

enforcement.static_check: Reject copy/broadcast primitives unless restricted to compatible/orthogonal families.
enforcement.runtime_gate: No-cloning inequality or fidelity bound for nonorthogonal pair; orthogonal pair as positive control.
enforcement.current_status: side-quest iter_223 gates this with NumPy; needs torch-native if moved into clean rebuild.

registry.name: No Primitive Probability
registry.statement: Probabilities are probe-derived statistics, never free distributions at root.

enforcement.static_check: Require every probability to name a POVM/effect/probe.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Same state under two probes gives different values; primitive-p null fails.
enforcement.current_status: side-quest iter_223 gates this; clean rebuild QIT-FEP uses effects/path evidence but no standalone EC09 gate.

registry.name: No Primitive Optimization Or Utility
registry.statement: Optimization requires a declared functional; there is no primitive best state.

enforcement.static_check: Require named objective/functional and domain for any optimum.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Show different admissible functionals pick different optima.
enforcement.current_status: side-quest iter_223 gates this; clean rebuild 005 reports readout disagreement.

registry.name: No Outside Observer
registry.statement: Probe and probed are represented in the same finite substrate; observer split is not primitive.

enforcement.static_check: Reject external observer variables that do not enter the joint state.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Represent observer/probed as rho_AB and show reduced state/back-action depends on joint construction.
enforcement.current_status: clean rebuild 004-005 use rho_AB cuts; no dedicated observer back-action gate yet.

registry.name: No Global Total Order
registry.statement: No scalar invariant may linearly rank all states or candidates by default.

enforcement.static_check: Reject scalar ranking unless it declares scope and incomparability behavior.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Construct same-entropy/different-operator states or incomparable readout vectors.
enforcement.current_status: clean rebuild 005/008 show no single Axis0 scalar survives; side-quest EC14 is advisory.

registry.name: No Semantic Smuggling
registry.statement: Renamed classical concepts must be rederived and retested under QIT constraints.

enforcement.static_check: Reject name reuse unless the classical property is re-proved or explicitly dropped.
enforcement.runtime_gate: Contrast classical MI positivity with coherent-information behavior and controls.
negative_controls: classical Markov blanket renamed quantum blanket
enforcement.current_status: clean rebuild QIT-FEP is scoped as candidate only; no final FEP/Axis0 semantics admitted.
